technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present potential bounce opportunity, but severe downtrend structure with price below all key moving averages, negative momentum, and bearish candlestick pattern create high risk of continued decline.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest create a weak fundamental backdrop with elevated earnings risk in 48 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (2+ years old) and absent recent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4) with flat yield curve and imminent FOMC decision create severe macro headwinds; utilities defensive positioning offers limited offset to systemic risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with supertrend bullish signal and price near support (36.28) offers contrarian bounce setup in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe downtrend structure with price below all major moving averages, negative MACD histogram, three black crows pattern, VIX crisis regime (406.4), and imminent FOMC decision create compounding systemic headwinds that overshadow oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) and supertrend bullish signal present technical bounce setup; however, severe downtrend structure with price below all major moving averages, negative MACD, three black crows pattern, and VIX crisis regime (406.4) create compounding systemic headwinds that overwhelm contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent FOMC decision combined with VIX crisis regime and macro deterioration could trigger further capitulation below current support (36.28), invalidating oversold bounce thesis.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear dominance; technical oversold conditions acknowledged but overridden by macro risk, fundamental weakness, and downtrend structure
